line: Bed drawer: the Stay tile now shows the day of the stay, for example "Day 37".
Cancelling community transport now names the patient, and the desk guides match what each desk can open.
Legal form times now show only as typed, such as "Ends 15:42 as typed", never as a countdown.
Settings: Restore now names all twelve rules, and Export saves only the saved rules.
Names now read surname first in the downtime pack, chronology file, community record and referral slide-out.
Capacity's ward panel only offers pages your desk can open.
Legal forms: Record the time written now takes a typed 24-hour time, as Record a form does.
The sidebar, header and phone dock are tidier: page name first, Alerts on every desk, and Demo from the board clock.
Home shows what changed since your last review in Activity, and a Planned list for the rest of the shift.
Capacity has a new look: beds ready first, the bed forecast, a bed map of every ward and this shift's checks.
Referrals and Ward answer are tidier: rows wrap in full, and Accept and Decline sit in a bar at the foot.
Waiting, Alerts, Legal forms, Patients, Movements and the patient record have a new look for each desk.
The ED board, All EDs, Transport and Out of area have a new look, with a simpler actions menu on the ED board.
Places, All wards, Community team, On-call and Seclusion are tidier, and names wrap in full.
Add a patient checks for duplicates as you type, and its Add patient button says what is still needed.
Settings is one page shaped by your login, with a short Rules that affect you card. Glare is now Bright light.
Help has one search box and three tabs, shows each login only what it can use, and the tour starts when you choose.
Handover sign-offs now belong to each ward, and a site bed manager can sign off its own site's handover.
Roles read Nurse in charge, Community team and Site bed manager; hidden names say "Name not shown on this desk".
The ED page is now a handover table with Presentation and Form choices, and one Lists card.
Alerts is redesigned, with a Today band, a side panel with one action bar, and Add units on a live broadcast.
